text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was injured during training, 
so we rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Injury status... "Red." Rest is prescribed 
for a full recovery...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, if the "inactivity" continues... 
the "phase difference" will make 
"connecting" difficult...

She seems to be saying that taking long 
breaks causes delays in training, making 
it harder to "connect" in races...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, request to alter mission. If we 
conduct 'training' in 'microgravity', we 
can minimize the impact......"

Neo Universe seemed to want to continue 
training by lightening her workload.
choice_data_list:
If I judge that it's too much, I'll stop 
it immediately.

text_block_list.text:
We couldn't overlook the risk of the 
injury worsening into an irreversible 
situation. I persuaded her not to rush and 
to take things slowly until it healed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe lost her sense of 
judgment. ...Self-reflection...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Averting the "end" is top priority... Now 
is the time for... "cryosleep," isn't it?
To heal her injury, Neo Universe rested.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Let's cancel today's training after all.

text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe gave up on training and 
focused entirely on recovering from her 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"EIO." There is no... "Spark." But 
pushing too hard is negative, so I will 
proceed with caution...

Keeping an eye on her injury, Neo Universe 
was able to do some light training.
